• Throw 🀡9-pin, not 🀔5-sou. Stay silent—don’t declare riichi yet. That keeps a ryanmen (two-sided open) wait. Throwing 🀡9-pin keeps draws like 🀓4-sou and 🀖7-sou.

• You’re tenpai (ready).
• Throwing 🀡9-pin builds toward ittsu (1–9 straight in one suit) / pinfu (closed all-sequences; no value pair).
• This discard leaves about 6 improving tiles left vs about 17 if you throw 🀔5-sou. Waiting on 🀓4-sou, 🀖7-sou (ryanmen (two-sided open)).
